reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) describes standard DSC for Cp and thermal entropy up to solidus in HEAs, but does not mention modulated DSC, simultaneous dilatometry, volume change measurements, or the claimed accuracy for fusion parameters. The key premises about the proposed combined technique are therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: MDSC can separate reversing (Cp) and non-reversing (latent heat) signals at high temperatures in HEAs
Simultaneous dilatometry can accurately measure volume change at melting for HEAs
